# Power-on factor word

u32 boot reason: 12 power switch, 0x1000001 battery connected, 0x400 USB cable, 0x1506 card inserted.

**Category:** data · **Address:** `0xa1c17c14` (runtime uncached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M10 Mark II firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-ii-1400.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II](../cameras/em10-ii.md)

0x1000001 covers a battery connected with the switch On and one inserted with the switch Off; fenykl tells them apart by the switch input. 0x1000002 is expected after a watchdog reset.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): Values and their boots as fenykl's loader gate reads them. Source: [fenykl plugin SDK](../sources/fenykl.sdk.md).
- **Physical camera** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): The loader's gate on 12 (power switch) and 0x1000001 (battery connected with the switch On) runs payloads on the maintainer's camera. Source: [fenykl overview and install](../sources/fenykl.readme.md).
